title: StarLeader's Performance Pack
description: A fabric client-side modpack that provides high performance with a few QOL improvements.
body:
## **The Gist**
StarLeader's Performance Pack fabric client-side modpack that provides high performance with a few QOL improvements.

## **Performance**
In my limited testing I have noticed 200%-300% FPS Boost depending on system specs

## **QOL features**
Mods like Better Tab, Mouse Tweaks, Xaero's Minimap, and Shulker Box Tooltip all add a small bit of QOL to this modpack. Check the credits to see all the mods!

## **Voice Chat**
This modpack contains proximity voice chat for use on vanilla servers that support it via the plugin.

## **Custom Splash Texts**
Included is my custom take on vanilla splash texts with most of the original lines as well as a couple new ones.

## **The Credits:**
The modlist, and resourcepacks tend to change from version to version so I'll try to just list the consistent entries.
